job: Show how many jobs are in progress and open the list from the top bar.
purpose: A pill in the top bar with a pulsing dot and a count, that opens a popover of what is running: a title, the time so far, a line of detail and an optional progress bar, each row a link to the run. The count is the number of rows in the popover and follows them; with none the pill is hidden, so a quiet account has a quiet bar.
useWhen: Work continues after the page that started it: crawls, agent runs, monitor checks, imports.
A person should find a long job from any screen without opening the page that started it.

avoidWhen.when: A job finished, failed or needs a decision.
One job on the page you are on, with its own progress.
The health of the product itself.

states.name: none running
states.how: hidden; set by shell.js when the popover has no .fd-running-item

states.name: open
states.how: aria-expanded="true" on the pill while its popover is open

states.name: phone
states.how: the label drops and the pill keeps the dot and the count

parts.role: The pill; a button that opens the popover. data-fd-running names the popover.
The number of rows in the popover.
The word 'running'; hidden on a phone.
One running job, a link to its run.
One line of detail, such as the step or the page count.

keyboard.does: Opens the popover from the pill.
Closes the popover and returns focus to the pill.
